# Fenrir Mobile

Phone management: Android phones and web protection for Apple devices. For teams who need to locate, protect, support and set rules for company and personal phones.

Fenrir Mobile is one of the [Fenrir apps](../README.md): it runs on its own, with its own dashboard, from this
repository with `FENRIR_APP=mobile`. It is free, self-hosted and released under the Apache License 2.0, as-is and
without support.

## What it does

- Android agent: enrol by QR code, standard set-up or an optional work profile for personal phones
- Location, lock, alarm, lost mode and wipe
- Remote view and control of the phone's screen (with the user's consent)
- Phone policy: passcode and security, restrictions, apps, network and updates, with compliance reporting and alerts
- App protection: installed apps checked against your allow and block lists
- Web protection for iPhone, iPad and Mac through a DNS configuration profile (no agent)

## Quick start

1. Fork this repository (or copy it into a private repository) and clone **your** copy onto a Linux server.
2. Point a domain name such as `mobile.yourcompany.com` at the server.
3. Run setup and choose this app:

   ```bash
   deploy/setup.sh --app mobile
   ```

   Setup asks for your domain, an administrator email and your organisation's name, writes `deploy/.env` with fresh
   secrets, and can build and start the server.
4. Open `https://mobile.yourcompany.com` and sign in with the email and the password setup printed.

The [full guide](GUIDE.md) covers every step in detail, first use, each page, configuration, updates, backups and
troubleshooting.

## The dashboard

| Menu | Page | What it is for |
|---|---|---|
| Home | **Dashboard** | The app's headline numbers and a way into each of its pages. |
| Endpoints | **Devices** | Every enrolled device. Open one for its health, system details, software, activity, remote session and effective policy. |
| Endpoints | **Device groups** | Organise each customer's devices, give groups their own policy, and target them with actions. |
| Endpoints | **Protection policies** | What agents do: scanning, real-time protection, DNS filtering, monitoring, updates, phone rules. One default per customer, overridable per group. |
| Endpoints | **Agent health** | Whether each agent is on the current build (and why not), and what it reported failing in the last 7 days. |
| Endpoints | **Deploy agents** | Choose an operating system and customer, then download an installer that enrols itself. |
| Admin | **Settings** | Customers (tenants), users and roles, custom fields, region and holidays, webhooks, API credentials, approvals, the audit log and platform options. |

## Requirements

| Item | Requirement |
|---|---|
| Server | Linux (Ubuntu 24.04 LTS on amd64 recommended), 4 vCPUs, 8 GB RAM plus 4 GB swap, 80 GB SSD. 16 GB RAM makes the first build faster. |
| Software | Docker Engine with buildx and Docker Compose 2.24.4 or newer, Git, curl, OpenSSL, Bash, Python 3. |
| Network | A domain name (DNS A record) pointing at the server; TCP 80 and 443 open; SSH restricted to you. Devices must reach the server over HTTPS. |
| Signing (optional) | A Windows code-signing certificate (.pfx). Without one, Windows agents are built unsigned and SmartScreen warns. |

## Not in this app

Windows, Linux and macOS management (the **rmm** app) and antivirus alerts (**av**). Phone compliance shows on each phone; it raises alerts in the **complete** platform. To add another app later, switch to `FENRIR_APP=complete` (see [the guide](GUIDE.md#adding-more-apps-later)); your data is kept.
